_note: Frozen vocab.json for the eval harness only (promotion-eval.md Decision 4) -- deliberately separate from ~/.config/folk/vocab.json so scoring is reproducible across machines and time, never silently drifting with someone's live, uncommitted config (invariant 7: this is config, not code, and it's committed like eval/baseline.json). The two aliases below resolve the entity-slug drift COMPARISON.md's second pass documented (finding 2) for the synthetic 2026-06-01 fixture session -- they are the literal example journal-in-folk.md uses for the aliases mechanism.
slug_rules: lowercase ascii, hyphen-separated, type prefix required

predicates.participated_in: subject took part in a conversation or event
predicates.uttered: subject said the message pointed to (journal-only, never indexed)
predicates.interested_in: subject has an ongoing interest in a topic
predicates.prioritizes: subject currently ranks this project or topic first (time-scoped; use when)
predicates.worked_through: subject processed or studied a body of material
predicates.worked_on: subject built or contributed to a project
predicates.values: subject holds this as a guiding value (identity-level: level=bedrock)
predicates.believes: subject holds this statement or axiom as true (identity-level: level=bedrock)
predicates.defining_moment: an identity-shaping experience of the subject (identity-level: level=bedrock)
predicates.motivated_by: an underlying driver inferred for the subject
predicates.assessed_most_meaningful: an agent's judgment ranking an artifact's significance
